verdict.line: You lose if you let K'Sante freely stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) for the level 2 pull-chain, but you win the long game at 52.5% over 141 games because your scaling and all-in burst outclass his flat defenses once W (All Out) is down.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has the raw lane tools — a slow on Q (Ntofo Strikes), a stun on W (Path Maker), and a mobility reset on E (Footwork) — so he wins trades he initiates cleanly. Cho'Gath's answer is that none of those tools stop Q (Rupture) into W (Feral Scream): the knockup-into-silence combo shuts down his dash-shield-stun chain mid-animation, and once E (Vorpal Spikes) is stacking on top of that, the exchange flips.

theirWindow.when: he has 2 Ntofo Strikes stacks up
theirWindow.what: He fires a shockwave that pulls you in on the second Q hit — stand outside 450 range or expect to be yanked into W (Path Maker) stun range immediately after.

yourWindow.when: W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is when he has no dash, no shield, and no stun. Walk up and land Q (Rupture) into W (Feral Scream) — the silence removes his only remaining answer, which is flashing away.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Taken in 77.8% of games (50.8% win rate over 130 games) — the extra sustain and mana regen let you spam Q (Rupture) and E (Vorpal Spikes) through his early Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke without running dry.

boots.why: 53.7% win rate over 82 games — K'Sante's damage is entirely physical through Q/W/E autos, and the flat reduction blunts his all-in burst specifically.

core.why: Gives you a gap-close to land Q (Rupture) into W (Feral Scream) even if he tries to kite with E (Footwork).
Sustained magic damage scaling that out-damages his flat armor stacking over a prolonged trade.
Closes the mobility gap against his dash kit while adding health and bonus damage on the charged auto.

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken in 63.5% of games at 30.2% pick rate (highest overall win rate of the two listed pages) — the sustained healing from auto-trading with E (Vorpal Spikes) procs outlasts his short-cooldown Q poke over a long lane.

summoners.why: Run in 50% of games at 77.2% pick rate when chosen — Teleport lets you reset after losing the level 1-2 trade window and still make it back for the level 6+ R (Feast) all-in window without missing waves.

playing.title: Bait the Q stack, don't eat it
playing.detail: He needs 2 Ntofo Strikes stacks for the pull shockwave. Take the first poke at range, then back off before the second — don't let him complete the chain into his W (Path Maker) stun.

playing.title: Rupture through his dash animation
playing.detail: Q (Rupture) has a 9s cooldown and 950 range — throw it the instant he commits E (Footwork) or W (Path Maker) forward, since both are dashes that can be caught mid-flight by the knockup.

playing.title: Silence cancels his reset, not his shield
playing.detail: W (Feral Scream)'s silence stops him from using E (Footwork) to disengage, but it doesn't strip an already-active shield — land it before he activates E, not after.

playing.title: Vorpal Spikes wins extended trades
playing.detail: E (Vorpal Spikes) procs on every auto with only a 0.5s cooldown. In a prolonged stand-still fight (which his short-CD kit invites), this chip damage adds up faster than his flat per-hit numbers.

playing.title: Feast on cooldown windows
playing.detail: R (Feast) has a 60s cooldown and 175 range true damage — use it the moment his W (Path Maker) is down (10-14s CD depending on rank) since he has no stun to punish your melee range commitment.

playing.title: Respect All Out level 6
playing.detail: His R (All Out) knocks back through walls and removes his own defenses for damage and healing — don't greed trades near walls once he's 6, since the knockback-wall combo into transformed abilities swings fights hard.

playing.title: Push waves when his E is down
playing.detail: E (Footwork) is his only disengage without flashing. Check its cooldown (10-8s by rank) before shoving — if it's down, he can't easily escape a full Q-W combo.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and the 52.5% win rate over 141 games are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability interactions, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical reading, not sourced from win-rate data.
